title: Are LLM Evaluators Really Narcissists? Sanity Checking Self-Preference Evaluations

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the probability that a judge model prefers its own outputs over those of other models, specifically isolating 'illegitimate self-preference' (ILSP) by comparing the judge's preference for its own incorrect/inferior responses against its preference for capability-matched proxy models' incorrect/inferior responses using an Evaluator Quality Baseline.
